layout.text: PHONE COMBAT: Standard and Story sequence new patrol attacks so amber warnings have time to read. Shots already in flight remain dangerous. Attacks starting outside the view warn longer; turning does not cancel them. Close discharges can be interrupted with DASH. A phone dash toward a body brakes before contact; sideways and retreating dashes keep their travel. Braking alone does not interrupt an attack or damage an enemy. Veteran keeps the faster original cadence.
